rows.grounds: kārayetpaścādbhūtamātṛbaliṃ = should-cause-afterward-being-mother-offering; sandhi/compound of kārayet (3sg.opt.act.caus √kṛ), paścāt (indecl.), bhūtamātṛbaliṃ (m.acc.sg tatpuruṣa compound: bhūta-mātṛ-bali)
śaṃkaramabhyarcya = having-worshipped-śaṃkara; compound of śaṃkaram (m.acc.sg) + abhyarcya (absolutive of abhi-√arc)
śayyāmastrābhimantritām = bed-consecrated-by-weapon-mantra; śayyām (f.acc.sg) + astrābhimantritām (f.acc.sg, past passive participle abhi-√mantr compounded with astra)
